# open
c1 "SELECT version()"
c1 "SET DateStyle = 'ISO, YMD'; SET IntervalStyle = 'postgres'; SET extra_float_digits = 3; SET client_encoding = 'UTF8'; SET TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta'; SET search_path = app, public;"
# server_info
c2 "SET DateStyle = 'ISO, YMD'; SET IntervalStyle = 'postgres'; SET extra_float_digits = 3; SET client_encoding = 'UTF8'; SET TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta'; SET search_path = app, public;"
c2 "SELECT version()::text, current_database()::text, current_user::text"
# list_databases
c2 "SELECT d.datname::text, pg_get_userbyid(d.datdba)::text AS owner, pg_encoding_to_char(d.encoding)::text AS encoding, d.datname = current_database() AS is_current FROM pg_database d WHERE NOT d.datistemplate AND d.datallowconn ORDER BY 1"
# list_schemas
c2 "SELECT n.nspname::text, COALESCE(n.nspname = (current_schemas(false))[1], false) AS is_default FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','pg_toast') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\\_temp\\_%' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\\_toast\\_temp\\_%' ORDER BY 1"
# list_tables
c2 "SELECT c.relname::text, c.relkind::text, obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class')::text, CASE WHEN c.reltuples < 0 THEN NULL ELSE c.reltuples::bigint END, CASE WHEN c.relkind IN ('r','p','m') THEN pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)::bigint END FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') ORDER BY c.relname"
# view_definition
c2 "SELECT pg_get_viewdef(c.oid, true)::text FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2 AND c.relkind IN ('v','m')"
# table_meta
c2 "SELECT (current_schemas(false))[1]::text"
c2 "SELECT c.relkind::text, obj_description(c.oid, 'pg_class')::text, CASE WHEN c.reltuples < 0 THEN NULL ELSE c.reltuples::bigint END FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2 AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f')"
c2 "SELECT a.attname::text, k.ord::int FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum = k.attnum WHERE con.contype = 'p' AND n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2 ORDER BY k.ord"
c2 "SELECT a.attnum::int, a.attname::text, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod)::text, t.typname::text, t.typtype::text, t.typcategory::text, bt.typname::text, bt.typtype::text, bt.typcategory::text, et.typname::text, NOT a.attnotnull, pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid)::text, a.attidentity::text, a.attgenerated <> '', col_description(c.oid, a.attnum)::text, (SELECT string_agg(e.enumlabel::text, E'\\x1f' ORDER BY e.enumsortorder) FROM pg_enum e WHERE e.enumtypid = COALESCE(bt.oid, t.oid)), (SELECT string_agg(e.enumlabel::text, E'\\x1f' ORDER BY e.enumsortorder) FROM pg_enum e WHERE e.enumtypid = t.typelem), CASE WHEN a.attcollation <> 0 AND a.attcollation <> t.typcollation THEN co.collname::text END, a.atttypmod::int, COALESCE(bt.typtypmod, -1)::int, (WITH RECURSIVE dom(base, depth) AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN t.typbasetype ELSE et.typbasetype END, 1 WHERE t.typtype = 'd' OR et.typtype = 'd' UNION ALL SELECT d.typbasetype, dom.depth + 1 FROM dom JOIN pg_type d ON d.oid = dom.base AND d.typtype = 'd') SELECT format_type(dom.base, NULL) || CASE WHEN t.typtype = 'd' THEN '' ELSE '[]' END FROM dom ORDER BY dom.depth DESC LIMIT 1) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid = a.atttypid LEFT JOIN pg_type bt ON t.typtype = 'd' AND bt.oid = t.typbasetype LEFT JOIN pg_type et ON t.typcategory = 'A' AND et.oid = t.typelem LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid = a.attrelid AND d.adnum = a.attnum LEFT JOIN pg_collation co ON co.oid = a.attcollation WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2 AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attnum"
c2 "SELECT i.relname::text, ix.indisunique, ix.indisprimary, am.amname::text, pg_get_indexdef(ix.indexrelid)::text, pg_get_expr(ix.indpred, ix.indrelid)::text, (SELECT string_agg(pg_get_indexdef(ix.indexrelid, k.ord::int, true), E'\\x1f' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(ix.indkey::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) WHERE k.ord <= ix.indnkeyatts), obj_description(ix.indexrelid, 'pg_class')::text, (SELECT string_agg(a.attname::text, E'\\x1f' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(ix.indkey::int2[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = ix.indrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum WHERE k.ord > ix.indnkeyatts) FROM pg_index ix JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = ix.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = ix.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND t.relname = $2 ORDER BY ix.indisprimary DESC, i.relname"
c2 "SELECT con.conname::text, con.confupdtype::text, con.confdeltype::text, fn.nspname::text, fc.relname::text, pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid)::text, (SELECT string_agg(a.attname::text, E'\\x1f' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum), (SELECT string_agg(a.attname::text, E'\\x1f' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(con.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.confrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum) FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_class fc ON fc.oid = con.confrelid JOIN pg_namespace fn ON fn.oid = fc.relnamespace WHERE con.contype = 'f' AND n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2 ORDER BY con.conname"
c2 "SELECT con.conname::text, pg_get_constraintdef(con.oid)::text, (SELECT string_agg(a.attname::text, E'\\x1f' ORDER BY k.ord) FROM unnest(con.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum, ord) JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = con.conrelid AND a.attnum = k.attnum) FROM pg_constraint con JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = con.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE con.contype = 'c' AND n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2 ORDER BY con.conname"
c2 "SELECT t.tgname::text, t.tgenabled <> 'D', pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid, true)::text FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2 ORDER BY t.tgname"
# completion_metadata
c2 "SELECT n.nspname::text, COALESCE(n.nspname = (current_schemas(false))[1], false) AS is_default FROM pg_namespace n WHERE n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','pg_toast') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\\_temp\\_%' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\\_toast\\_temp\\_%' ORDER BY 1"
c2 "SELECT (current_schemas(false))[1]::text"
c2 "SELECT n.nspname::text, c.relname::text, string_agg(a.attname::text, E'\\x1f' ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema','pg_toast') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\\_temp\\_%' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg\\_toast\\_temp\\_%' GROUP BY n.nspname, c.relname ORDER BY 1, 2"
